name: DES J0322-5234 (Hubble)
blurb: DES J0322-5234, a candidate strong gravitational lens, seen by Hubble.
label: desj03225234-hubble
story: Picked out in Dark Energy Survey images as a likely case of strong lensing, where the gravity of foreground matter stretches the light of a background galaxy into arcs.

claims.text: DESJ0322-5234 is a candidate strongly lensed galaxy system from the DES Bright Arcs Survey
It ranked high in visual inspection
It was found in the search around redMaPPer clusters and redMaGiC galaxies
